facts.claim: Armur Town is the headquarters of the tdluk of the same name in Nizamabad District, Hyderabad State.
facts.quote: Armur Town. — Head-quarters of the tdluk of the same name in Nizamabad District, Hyderabad State, situated in 18° 48' N. and 78° 16' K., 16 miles north-east of Nizamabad jown.

facts.claim: The population of Armur Town in 1901 was 9,031.
Armur Town contains a sub-post office, a police inspector’s office, a dispensary, and a school with 127 pupils.
facts.quote: It contains a sub-post office, a police inspector’s office, a dispensary, and a school with 127 pupils.
